title: Circuit-bend rack
description: Simulate bending a cheap digital camera's sensor bus and frame memory the way real benders do (docs/RESEARCH.md section 1): the image travels as a YUV422 byte stream (Y0 U Y1 V) from sensor to DSP to frame buffer, and each control is a real bend point - a data line D0-D7 tied high/low through a pot, bridged or crossed data lines, data-to-clock crosstalk, byte-phase slip, a pot on the pixel clock, lost HSYNC (wrong stride), lost VSYNC (vertical roll), a stuck frame-buffer address line, a wrong Bayer phase, sensor config-bus corruption, JPEG bit errors, field errors and brownout.

clauses.text: With every control at rest, the bend stage passes the picture through untouched.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "neutral rack is a perfect bypass" passes

clauses.text: Data-line bends act on the bytes on the bus: a hard short forces the bit on every byte, an open pot leaves the bus alone, and in between the bit flips intermittently in proportion to the pot; bridged lines AND/OR together and crossed lines swap bits.
clauses.observable_by: tests named "stuck data line forces the bit through the pot" and "bridged and crossed lines rewire bits" pass

clauses.text: Timing bends move pixels the way the real faults do: a wrong line stride slants and wraps the picture, a pot on the pixel clock does nothing until past its knee and then tears lines sideways, and lost VSYNC rolls the picture with a black blanking bar at the seam.
clauses.observable_by: tests named "hsync loss rewraps lines at the wrong stride", "pixel clock pot has a knee" and "vsync loss rolls with a blanking bar" pass

clauses.text: A stuck frame-buffer address line repeats blocks of the picture and leaves stale memory from earlier frames showing through.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "stuck address line repeats blocks and leaves stale frames" passes

clauses.text: A wrong Bayer phase gives the documented colour swaps: one pixel across swaps red and green, one across and one down swaps red and blue.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "bayer phase error swaps colour channels" passes

clauses.text: Every other control visibly changes the picture, the same settings and seed always give the same picture, and odd or tiny frames never crash.
clauses.observable_by: tests named "every control changes the picture" and "odd and tiny frames are safe" pass

cases.description: default BendSettings returns a frame equal to the input
D7 high with pot shorted sets bit 7 on every byte; pot open changes nothing; pot halfway affects about half the eligible bytes
known bytes through AND bridge, OR bridge and a swap of two lines give exact expected values
stride +d reads row y from stream position y*(W+d)
pot below the knee leaves every line in place, pot fully turned shifts many lines
the picture moves down frame to frame and contains black blanking rows
address bit stuck low duplicates the following block; stuck high leaves a region holding the previous frame
a flat red frame turns green with phase (1,0) and blue with (1,1)
each control engaged alone changes a test chart, and repeated runs with the same seed are identical
1x1, 3x1, 1x5 and 7x3 frames with every control engaged
